We need to indicate number of CH3 groups in the molecule. But we have no description of molecule. Possibly need to retrieve NMR spectra to infer methyl groups. Could use proton NMR to count methyl signals. But we don't have SMILES. The system likely has a sample at hand (the "sample at hand") for which we can run NMR. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool (no args) to get 1H NMR. Then count methyl peaks (singlet, doublet, triplet around 0.9-1.5 ppm). Could also use carbon NMR to count methyl carbons (~10-30 ppm). Simpler: get carbon NMR and count signals in that region.

We'll call proton_nmr_spectra first.
